# ApproximantLattice

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-23

## Definition
A finite periodic supercell that approximates an aperiodic or quasicrystalline topological structure while preserving local symmetry. Allows numerical simulation and physical realization of topological phenomena in quasicrystal-like interconnect topologies.
